entries.reason: A remote-only, sidecar-only or debug-only app no longer compiles the HTTP stack. Users per rg: serve.rs uses axum, reqwest, rustls (ring provider), tokio (net::TcpListener) and http; proxy.rs uses http. sidecar.rs is std plus tauri only, so it needs no feature (the design's `sidecar` feature was not created, written reason). url, serde, serde_json, open, tauri stay unconditional (config, policy, window). Without the feature, a wrap.json with mode `bundle` is refused in the plugin setup (synchronous, before any window or thread) with: "this build has no bundle server: enable the `bundle` feature"; WrapConfig still parses a bundle section (Bundle carries allow(dead_code) when the feature is off). Tests of proxy.rs (7) and serve.rs (1) live in the gated modules; the shared policy test reads design/aphrody-m3/packages/web-to-tauri/fixtures/policy-cases.json and does not depend on the feature. Unit tests: 23 existing + 5 moved from tauri-debug = 28 under default features; 15 + 5 = 20 with --no-default-features.
